'''Darth Venemal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He served alongside the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] during the Empire's [[Battle of Ord Radama|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], which was successful at first. However, the Sith forces led by Venemal and Malgus were not resupplied, and their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] was attacked by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. Venemal&mdash;who remained in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Livien Magnus]] while Malgus attempted to aid in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle&mdash;was [[Death/Legends|killed]] with the city's populace when a crippled Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] crashed into Livien Magnus.

==Biography==
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Venemal, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], served as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]&ndash;spanning conflict between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="BoS" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3660 BBY]],<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref> during the Empire's [[Rim Campaign|campaign]] to secure [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Venemal and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] were tasked with leading Imperial forces&mdash;including a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Imperial soldier|soldiers]] and small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]]&mdash; to [[Battle of Ord Radama|recapture]] the planet [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].<ref name="BoS" /> During the [[Jedi Civil War]] approximately [[3959 BBY|three hundred years]] earlier, the planet had been allied with the Sith Lords [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], but was brought back into the Republic following the Jedi Civil War's [[Battle of Rakata Prime|end]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Their assault was initially successful and after about twenty days of fighting, their forces had captured the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Livien Magnus]], Ord Radama's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. The [[Dark Council]] dispatched Lord [[Adraas]] to assist Malgus and Venemal, and Adraas attempted to take credit for the pair's success.

However, the Sith forces on the planet were not resupplied and they were eventually overcame; Venemal was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] crashed in the center of Livien Magnus. Malgus could [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] his pain and death, along with that of a hundred thousand others. The Sith Empire was forced to withdraw from Ord Radama, and Malgus received some of the blame for Venemal's death and the defeat.

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Venemal was created by [[Daniel Wallace]] and was featured in the [[2012]] publication ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''. Wallace intended Venemal's name to be a reference to the "[[Wikipedia:Veni, vidi, vici|Veni, vidi, vici]]" quote of the statesman [[Wikipedia:Julius Caesar|Julius Caesar]].<ref name="Book of Sith endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)}}</ref>
